test_policy.notes: Test-optional for freshmen. For international applicants an ACT 20 or SAT 1030 is requested only if the evaluated GPA is below 3.0 or when applying for scholarships. Scholarships needing a minimum score count scores on file by Dec. 1.

requirements.notes: $60 fee for international students ($50 domestic). Certified, translated transcripts; MSU recommends a NACES-member course-by-course evaluation. Common App opens Aug. 5; MSU's own application opens Aug. 1.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application (rolling)
deadlines.notes: The catalog says fall applications should be received by Aug. 1; the freshman page says the application stays open until the 10th day of classes. Students outside the U.S. should apply at least four months before enrollment. Decisions usually take 2-3 weeks once materials are complete.

deadlines.label: Priority date for the General Scholarship Application (incoming freshmen)
deadlines.notes: Application opens Oct. 1. The automatic non-resident academic scholarship needs no separate application.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of a list of English-speaking countries are exempt, as are degree-seeking freshmen with two years at and graduation from an accredited U.S. high school with at least a C in English. Intensive English training does not by itself waive the requirement, but students who lack a qualifying score enroll in the English Language Institute (ELI), and completing ELI counts as demonstrating proficiency. Some departments require higher scores.

english.notes: The page does not mention the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.
MSU policy AOP 12.29 (2023) lists 120; the current admissions page says 105.

aid.notes: Non-resident academic scholarship is awarded automatically on admission by 9th-11th grade GPA, renewable up to 4 years (fall 2027 entrants): $12,000/yr at 3.30-3.59, $16,000/yr at 3.60-4.09, $19,000/yr at 4.10+. Competitive awards (e.g. Maroon and White) need the General Scholarship Application and qualifying SAT/ACT by Dec. 1. Students with active agent contracts are ineligible. Need-based aid for internationals is not mentioned.

toefl.note: The international admissions page does not print a TOEFL institution code.

pte.note: PTE is not on the list of accepted English tests.

tier_notes.engineering: Roughly in the 41-100 national band for this field, based on widely cited program reputations (our estimate, not a sourced figure). Bagley College of Engineering is a large research engineering college.
